license_required.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to practice optometry in this state unless he shall have first obtained a certificate of registration from the board

issuing_authority.quote: It shall be the duty of the Governor to appoint a State Board of Optometry

name.quote: This board shall be appointed by the Governor and styled the "State Board of Optometry."

type.quote: It shall be the duty of the Governor to appoint a State Board of Optometry to consist of six members.

umbrella_agency.value: Professional Licensing Boards Division, Office of the Secretary of State
umbrella_agency.quote: There is created within the office of the Secretary of State the professional licensing boards division

age_minimum.quote: Be 21 years of age and of good moral character

moral_character_required.quote: Be 21 years of age and of good moral character

degree_required.value: Doctor of Optometry (four-year degree from accredited college of optometry)
degree_required.quote: Hold a certificate of graduation from an accredited college or university teaching optometry, acceptable to the board, requiring a course of study therein of at least four school years.

accrediting_body.value: Board-approved accredited college or university teaching optometry
accrediting_body.quote: Hold a certificate of graduation from an accredited college or university teaching optometry, acceptable to the board

exams.name: Board-approved optometry examination
exams.notes: Required for applicants not qualifying by comity
exams.quote: Any other applicant for registration under this chapter shall be required to pass an examination approved by the board.

exams.name: Board-approved pharmacology examination for treatment purposes
exams.notes: Required for certification to use pharmaceutical agents for treatment purposes; must test knowledge of pharmacology for treatment and management of ocular diseases
exams.quote: Has passed or passes an examination approved by the board which tests knowledge of pharmacology for treatment and management of ocular diseases

interval_years.quote: Each person practicing optometry shall register biennially with the division director

required.quote: The minimum number of hours of continuing education required shall be fixed by the board by February 1 of each calendar year.

period_years.quote: Each person practicing optometry shall register biennially with the division director by completing and filing a form to be furnished by the board.

available.quote: The applicant shall be registered and given a certificate of registration if he or she holds a valid license from such other state boards of optometry as may be, under the rules of comity, recognized by the board.

requirements.value: Must hold a valid license from another state board of optometry recognized by the Georgia board under rules of comity; must pay the applicable registration fee.
requirements.quote: The applicant shall be registered and given a certificate of registration if he or she holds a valid license from such other state boards of optometry as may be, under the rules of comity, recognized by the board. The fee for registering such applicant shall be in an amount determined by the board.

is_mandatory.quote: Any person who practices optometry or who offers or pretends to practice or holds himself or herself out as eligible to practice optometry and who is not legally registered and licensed shall be guilty of a felony.

title_protection.quote: Any person who practices optometry or who offers or pretends to practice or holds himself or herself out as eligible to practice optometry and who is not legally registered and licensed shall be guilty of a felony.

scope_protection.quote: The practice of optometry by any unregistered or unlicensed optometrist is declared to be a menace and a nuisance and dangerous to the public health and safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant or licensee is not of good moral character
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board shall refuse to issue its certificate of registration and may revoke its certificate of registration issued to any person who is not of good moral character

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commits an act involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: or who commits an act involving moral turpitude
or who is guilty of unprofessional conduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Certificate was issued through error, fraud, or perjury
disciplinary_grounds.quote: or whose certificate was issued through error, fraud, or perjury

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly makes any fraudulent, misleading, or deceptive statement in any form of advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: or who knowingly makes any fraudulent, misleading, or deceptive statement in any form of advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Makes any statement in advertising concerning the quality of optometric services rendered
disciplinary_grounds.quote: or who makes any statement in any advertising concerning the quality of optometric services rendered by the registrant or licensee or any optometrist associated with him.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a license contained in this Code section, or under the laws, rules, or regulations under which licensure is sought or held

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practiced fraud or deceit or intentionally made any false statement in obtaining a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practiced fraud or deceit or intentionally made any false statement in obtaining a license to practice the licensed business or profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of any felony or of any crime involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been convicted of any felony or of any crime involving moral turpitude in the courts of this state or any other state, territory, or country or in the courts of the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had license revoked, suspended, or annulled by any other lawful licensing authority
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Had his or her license to practice a business or profession licensed under this title revoked, suspended, or annulled by any lawful licensing authority other than the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in any unprofessional, immoral, unethical, deceptive, or deleterious conduct or practice harmful to the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in any unprofessional, immoral, unethical, deceptive, or deleterious conduct or practice harmful to the public that materially affects the fitness of the licensee or applicant to practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aided, assisted, or encouraged any unlicensed person to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly performed any act which in any way aids, assists, procures, advises, or encourages any unlicensed person or any licensee whose license has been suspended or revoked by a professional licensing board to practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a statute, law, or any rule or regulation relating to the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated a statute, law, or any rule or regulation of this state, any other state, the professional licensing board regulating the business or profession licensed under this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudged mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been adjudged mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction within or outside this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Displayed an inability to practice with reasonable skill and safety to the public due to illness or substance use
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Displayed an inability to practice a business or profession licensed under this title with reasonable skill and safety to the public or has become unable to practice the licensed business or profession with reasonable skill and safety to the public by reason of illness or the use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to comply with an order for child support
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to comply with an order for child support as defined by Code Section 19-11-9.3

definition_quote.value: The practice of optometry consists of the diagnosis and interpretation of the visual behavior of the human organism by the employment of any means other than surgery. The practice of optometry further consists of the correction of visual anomalies through the prescribing, employment, and use of lenses, prisms, frames, mountings, contact lenses, orthoptic exercises, and visual training, light frequencies, and any other means or methods for the relief, correction, or remedy of any insufficiencies or abnormal conditions of the human visual organism, other than surgery.

drug_authority.value: Certified optometrists may use pharmaceutical agents for diagnostic and treatment purposes, including certain oral analgesics, hydrocodone (orally), Schedule III and IV oral analgesics for ocular pain, and other agents related to eye and adnexa oculi diseases except Schedule I or II controlled substances. May not dispense pharmaceutical agents to patients.
drug_authority.quote: Nothing in this chapter shall prohibit the use, administration, or prescription of pharmaceutical agents for diagnostic purposes and treatment of ocular disease in the practice of optometry by optometrists who have received pharmacological training and certification from a properly accredited institution of higher learning and who are certified by the board to use pharmaceutical agents for diagnostic and treatment purposes.

surgery_prohibited.quote: The practice of optometry consists of the diagnosis and interpretation of the visual behavior of the human organism by the employment of any means other than surgery.

value: injections related to diagnosis or treatment of diseases and conditions of the eye and adnexa oculi (excluding sub-tenon, retrobulbar, peribulbar, facial nerve block, subconjunctival anesthetic, dermal filler, intravenous, intramuscular, intraorbital nerve block, intraocular, or botulinum toxin injections)
minor_surgical_procedures_authorized.quote: A doctor of optometry may administer pharmaceutical agents related to the diagnosis or treatment of diseases and conditions of the eye and adnexa oculi by injection, except for sub-tenon, retrobulbar, peribulbar, facial nerve block, subconjunctival anesthetic, dermal filler, intravenous injections, intramuscular injections, intraorbital nerve block, intraocular, or botulinum toxin injections

value: Schedule III and IV oral analgesics permitted for ocular pain only

opioid_prescription_day_limit.quote: with respect to hydrocodone, used for no more than 48 hours without consultation with the patient's physician

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: Nonnarcotic oral analgesics, hydrocodone administered orally, and Schedule III or Schedule IV controlled substances which are oral analgesics

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: Nothing in this chapter shall prohibit the use, administration, or prescription of pharmaceutical agents for diagnostic purposes and treatment of ocular disease in the practice of optometry by optometrists who have received pharmacological training and certification from a properly accredited institution of higher learning and who are certified by the board to use pharmaceutical agents for diagnostic and treatment purposes.

value: certification to use pharmaceutical agents for diagnostic purposes
certification to use pharmaceutical agents for treatment purposes
specialty_certification_types.quote: Only a doctor of optometry who: (i) Is already certified for using pharmaceutical agents for diagnostic purposes; (ii) Has passed or passes an examination approved by the board which tests knowledge of pharmacology for treatment and management of ocular diseases; (iii) Is certified in coronary pulmonary resuscitation (CPR); and (iv) Maintains at least $1 million in malpractice insurance coverage shall be certified to use pharmaceutical agents for treatment purposes.

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: consisting of a minimum of 30 hours approved by the board

supervised_clinical_internship_required.quote: Is under the direct supervision of a physician licensed under Chapter 34 of this title and board certified in ophthalmology.

referral_to_physician_required.quote: If the glaucoma patient does not respond to the topically administered pharmaceutical agents after 60 days of treatment, that patient must be referred to an ophthalmologist

comanagement_with_ophthalmologist_requir.quote: If the patient is diagnosed as having closed angle glaucoma, the patient shall be immediately referred to an ophthalmologist
